newsitem.title: USA: MVSI to design system for Ford.
newsitem.headline: MVSI to design system for Ford.

text.p: MVSI Inc said Thursday it had entered into a project with another company to design for the Ford Motor Co a system to inspect the welding around the drum-to-gear interface of automobiles.
The company said the joint development project with Rofin-Sinar Technologies Inc will retrofit a laser welding station with an inspection system.
The weld is needed to ensure that the transmission operates safely, it said.
MVSI said it had to design the system within the "next few weeks" for tests by Ford and Rofin-Sinar.
If approved, Ford will use the system at one of its plants, it added.
